title: Intern (Operations Excellence)
description:
Job Title
 **Intern – Operations Excellence** 




 Department:
 **Operations Excellence** 




 Reporting To:
 **Head – Operations Excellence / Industrial Engineering** 




 Internship Duration:
 **6 Months** 




  





**Role Objective** 




 To support the Operations Excellence team in driving productivity improvement, mechanization, automation, layout optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations. The intern will gain hands\-on exposure to Industrial Engineering tools, Lean Manufacturing principles, and project execution while contributing to operational excellence projects.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Process Improvement \& Industrial Engineering
 


* Assist in conducting time studies, work studies, and motion studies.
* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend improvement opportunities.
* Support implementation of Lean Manufacturing tools and Continuous Improvement initiatives.
* Assist in identifying and eliminating Non\-Value Added (NVA) activities.



 Key Deliverables
 


* Process improvement opportunities identified
* Improved process flow and standardized work practices



 2\. Mechanization \& Automation Projects
 


* Support execution of mechanization and automation projects across operations.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors during project implementation.
* Assist in machine trials, validation, documentation, and performance tracking.
* Monitor project timelines and maintain implementation trackers.



 Key Deliverables
 


* Timely project support
* Successful implementation tracking
* Automation project documentation



 3\. Layout Planning \& Workflow Optimization
 


* Assist in preparing and updating shop\-floor layouts using AutoCAD or equivalent software.
* Support workstation redesign to improve ergonomics and material flow.
* Participate in layout optimization activities for improved productivity and space utilization.
* Assist in material flow analysis and workstation balancing.



 Key Deliverables
 


* Optimized layouts
* Improved workflow and space utilization
* Reduced material movement



 4\. Productivity \& Capacity Improvement
 


* Collect and analyze production data.
* Prepare productivity reports and dashboards.
* Support capacity calculations and manpower utilization studies.
* Participate in bottleneck identification and capacity enhancement initiatives.



 Key Deliverables
 


* Productivity improvement reports
* Capacity analysis support
* Performance dashboards



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Education** 



* Final Year or Pre\-final Year B.E./B.Tech or pursuing Master's in:
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Production Engineering
* Manufacturing Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Industrial \& Production Engineering



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Basic understanding of Lean Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering concepts
* Knowledge of Time Study, Motion Study, Line Balancing, and Process Mapping
* AutoCAD (preferred)
* Microsoft Excel \& PowerPoint
* Power BI (preferred)
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good communication and presentation skills
* Ability to work in a cross\-functional environment
* Proactive learning attitude



  





**Learning Outcomes** 




**During the internship, the candidate will gain practical exposure to:** 



* Industrial Engineering practices
* Manufacturing process optimization
* Mechanization and Automation projects
* Shop\-floor layout planning
* Lean Manufacturing implementation
* Continuous Improvement methodologies
* Project Management
* Cross\-functional stakeholder management
* Data analysis and reporting
* Manufacturing Operations Excellence

title: Turbine Manual Technical Writer
description:
The Turbine Manual Technical Writer will work for world\-class nuclear steam turbines, which are industry\-leading equipment in terms of performance, availability and power and will play a central role in the success of New projects.
   

  

 Primary Activities
   

  

 Scope
   

  

* The Turbine Manual Technical writer will work for world\-class nuclear steam turbines, which are industry leading equipment in terms of performance, availability and power and will play a central role in mechanical engineering performance


 Main Duties
   

  

* Prepare manuals for erection, operation and maintenance of the Nuclear Steam Turbines.
* Collaborate with product design teams and other external teams to maintenance standard manuals and customize project manuals.


**Responsibilities**
* Creation and maintenance of standardized Erection/Maintenance, Illustrations, Description manuals.
* Customize Manuals according to project specifications.
* Create turbine component illustration for all projects
* Create and sort procedurs, instructions and other support document for manuals as per product.
* Coordinate with product design teams and other externals teams working on features included in manuals.
* Adapt Erection/Maintenance manuals according to manufacturing or design changes and Directive machine residual risks.
* Collaborate with product design teams and PEMs for planning and tracking input and output for project customermized manuals.
* Ensures that Nuclear Safety Items and Activities are Identified and closely monitored.
* Participate to ITNS Gates Reviews
* Be informed and take into account the regulations inherent to the design and safe production of the products concerned and take the life cycle into account.
* Follow company EHS rules


 Required Competences
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering


**Experience**
* 5 years of engineering experiences in design office or site (energy, oil \& gas, aerospace, special machineries)


 Behavioural and/or Technical Know\-how
   

  

* Strong technical writing skills on describing activies for mechanical equipment
* Good mechanical\-design fundamentals
* Knowledge of Turbine product, Generator product or other nuclear power plant equipment appreciated.
* Use of common IT tools: Excel, Word, Power Point, Outlook
* Experienced user of advanced CAD software: Catia V5, Catia Composer
* 3DVia user (preferred)
* User of PLM software: Enovia (preferred)
* Rigorous and processes oriented.
* Strong interpersonal and team leadership skills.
* Strong autonomy.
* Decision\-maker.


 Language skills
   

  

* English: fluent (fluency: speaking, listening comprehension, reading, and writing.)


 Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
   

  

 At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

title: Application Expert- Drives & Automation
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Assistant Manager/Manager
 



  





**Location** 
 : Sanand, Gujarat
 



  





**Company** 
 : Hitachi Hi\-Rel Power Electronics Private Limited
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
 



 2\.Conduct joint technical visits with channel partners to key OEMs, Industrial End\-Users, and Automation Consultants to influence technical specifications in favour of our Japanese technology.
 



 3\.Analyze customer technical requirements, perform sizing, selection, and configuration of drives, and prepare robust, foolproof technical proposals. Troubleshoot complex application challenges during the pre\-sales phase to demonstrate product superiority and build customer confidence.
 



 4\.Design and deliver structured technical training programs, product certification courses, and application workshops for System Integrators (SIs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), and Distributors.
 



 5\.Create a self\-reliant channel ecosystem by empowering partner engineers to handle standard configurations and basic commissioning independently.
 



 6\.Provide continuous technical mentoring and application support to the internal team of 7–8 regional channel managers.
 



 7\.Perform deep technical benchmarking against key competitors (e.g., ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Schneider, Fuji, Yaskawa Etc) to identify our product USPs and counter competitor arguments.
 



 8\.Develop localized application notes, success stories, and technical whitepapers to support the field sales team.
 



 Gather market intelligence on required product modifications, software features, or customized firmware, feeding this data back to the global Japanese R\&D and Product Management teams.
 



**Education Qualifications** 
 : B.E \- Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Electronics/EC/ Industrial Engg.
 



**Experience** 
 : Min. 10 years with min 6\-7 Yrs of strictly focus on LV Product Technical support across various industries
 



  





**Essential Knowledge \& skills:** 
 Experience of LV Drive Application knowledge in various fields, PLC programming, code writing, Good Presentation skills, Training ability
 



  





**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills:** 
 LV Drive market knowledge and product knowledge. Gujarati, Hindi and English language proficiency. Should be local resident, ready to travel across India.
